page.overview:
Who is Limbo?

Limbo was a male Baryonyx, and a supporting antagonist of the animated series Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous, serving as one of the three tertiary antagonists of season 2, a minor character in Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous: Hidden Adventure and season 3, and a supporting antagonist in season 5. Limbo has two other companions, Chaos and Grim, who are presumably his siblings.

Limbo is a Baryonyx comprised of brown and dark yellow complexion, he is the only known Baryonyx to have this sort of coloration.

Limbo cares deeply for his companions, tracking down Grim when she had been separated from Limbo and Chaos and both of the latter tracking down and killing Tiff when she killed Grim. The pack didn't always get along however, and Limbo would occasionally squabble with Chaos in the middle of hunts. Limbo was seemingly easily distracted as well, as he chose to hunt some people they encountered over helping Chaos' attempts to free Grim.

Limbo was one of the Baryonyx kept at Jurassic World, where he formed a close bond with other members of his species Chaos and Grim. At some point Grim was taken to a medical center on the island, eventually being abandoned there when the Jurassic World Incident forced the island to be abandoned.
